doc: One wind bone: a stretch of trunk or branch that bends as one, about its pivot.

fields.name: parent
fields.doc: Parent bone, or -1 for the root.

fields.name: pivot
fields.doc: Where it bends, in the rest pose (metres, tree space).

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: Unit direction along the wood, from the pivot.

fields.name: length
fields.doc: Length of wood carried beyond the pivot, metres.

fields.name: frequency
fields.doc: First natural sway frequency, Hz (cantilever beam, Moore and Maguire 2004 range).

fields.name: drag
fields.doc: Bend in radians at a steady 10 m/s wind.

fields.name: piece
fields.doc: The break piece this bone belongs to.
